title: feat: add Jev typed-decision model and Jev MCP server
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
Jev (TypeSafe AI) answers typed questions with calibrated confidence instead of free text.

- Adds `typesafe/jev` (alias `jev`) as a text model. The native TypeSafe request (`state` + a map of `questions`) is JSON in the last user message; the native `answers` object comes back as the assistant content. Same shape as the System One API, proxied through Chat Completions — no new public endpoint.
- OpenAI-client compatible: system messages and earlier turns are ignored (like the media models), and `stream: true` returns the finished answers as one content chunk, the usage chunk, then `[DONE]`. No token-by-token streaming.
- Malformed input returns a 400 with the required shape and a docs link.
- Adds `apps/ask-jev-mcp`, a bring-your-own-key MCP server with one `jev_decide` tool that calls gen internally.
- Bought through OpenRouter's decisions endpoint, so it needs no new provider credential — every environment already carries `OPENROUTER_API_KEY`.
- Billed from Quest Pollen (`paidOnly: false`) at $0.042/M input, $0 output, `priceMultiplier: 1` (no margin).

### Confirmed contract

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Canonical name | `typesafe/jev` |
| Aliases | `jev` |
| `priceMultiplier` | 1 |
| `paidOnly` | false |
| Pollinations GPU | no |
| Registry provider | `openrouter` |
| Primary route | `POST openrouter.ai/api/alpha/decisions`, upstream `typesafe/jev-1.13` |
| Fallback | none |

### Why OpenRouter and not TypeSafe directly

OpenRouter serves Jev at `POST /api/alpha/decisions`, not `/chat/completions`, which refuses it outright. That endpoint takes the native TypeSafe body and returns the native answers, at list price with no markup (measured: `usage.cost` 1.3734e-05 for 327 input tokens = $0.042/M). Buying there reuses the `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` already deployed everywhere, so the model ships without a new secret. The cost is a version pin — OpenRouter exposes no floating alias, so `typesafe/jev-1.13` is pinned in the model config and new releases need a registry b

gist.headline: Decisions, but typed
gist.blurb: The hive gained a careful little oracle. Jev turns structured questions into typed answers with calibrated confidence, and it is available through chat or a tiny MCP tool.
gist.summary: Added the `typesafe/jev` text model (alias `jev`) through Chat Completions, proxying TypeSafe's native `state` plus `questions` decision format to OpenRouter's pinned `typesafe/jev-1.13`, alongside an `ask-jev-mcp` server exposing `jev_decide`.
gist.impact: Developers can now request structured, confidence-calibrated answers without a new endpoint or provider key, with completed answers returned as a single chunk when `stream: true` is used.
